events.name: Initial-collapse deaths recognized
events.summary: Carl concludes that the people whose likenesses appeared in the hydra died in the initial collapse, including Sam, Mr. Roth, Asher and his stepmother. This reveals past deaths, not current crawler deaths.

events.subject: Carl’s father
events.name: Death by morphine overdose
events.summary: Carl explicitly reports that his stepmother killed his father with a morphine overdose before the dungeon. The earlier memory showed the injection.

events.subject: Angel
events.name: Initial-collapse death reported
events.summary: Carl reports that Angel was at home and died in the collapse; Carl and Donut were the only ones to escape their building, with Ferdinand also surviving.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Environmental heat immunity upgraded
events.summary: Carl’s Burn immunity now also prevents environmental damage in heat or lava environments such as Sheol. Direct contact with fire or lava is not covered.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Emberus Devotee rank
events.summary: Carl advances to Devotee, the highest worship rank available to him without a Cleric or Paladin class. His tithe rises from five to ten percent.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Self-Immolation
events.summary: Emberus grants Carl level-10 Self-Immolation, usable once per obeisance day while in good standing. It costs no mana and does not protect against direct contact with the resulting fire or lava.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Champion Pack awarded
events.summary: The keymaster reward offers the squad leader two reserve totem slots, a trophy, a cooler of yellow Gatorade and two Flee cards. Carl cannot collect it because he is not the squad leader.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Alpha Carl totem card
events.summary: Alpha Carl is automatically added to Donut’s cards despite her and Carl deciding not to keep it. The card is a replica, not Carl himself.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Leveled-Up Frank totem card
events.summary: A level-90 Blood Assassin Night Elf card modeled on Frank Q is automatically added to Donut’s cards. It is not a resurrection or new level of the real Frank.

events.subject: Chuy
events.name: Death
events.summary: Carl examines Chuy’s corpse on the beach. The readout identifies a level-65 Monk Seal Warrior killed in mass combat.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Unidentified beach corpse
events.summary: Carl starts taking corpses from the beach for their loot. The identity of the first collected corpse is not explicitly repeated.

events.subject: Mistress Tiatha
events.name: Character level
events.summary: Elle’s manager Mistress Tiatha is a level-50 Half-Elf Green Caster and a non-combatant NPC.

events.subject: Chris
events.name: Early-generation iPod
events.summary: Louis explains that the iPod playing the party music belongs to Chris, who brought it into the dungeon.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Christmas decorations
events.summary: Louis has collected the decorations from memory areas. He explicitly says these items disappear at the end of the floor.

events.subject: Ruby
events.name: Gloria Estefan cassette tape
events.summary: Louis gives Ruby the Gloria Estefan cassette tape he found; she owns a Walkman.

events.subject: Ruby
events.name: Walkman
events.summary: Louis confirms Ruby owns an old Walkman.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Turkey corpses
events.summary: Carl gives the bopca five ordinary turkey corpses to roast. He explicitly avoids the corpses touched by the Worm Fulcrum.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Boss Box from the two deckmasters awarded
events.summary: Carl receives Boss Box from the two deckmasters after the card battles.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gold Gobble Box awarded
events.summary: Carl receives Gold Gobble Box after the card battles.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gold Talk of the Town Box awarded
events.summary: Carl receives Gold Talk of the Town Box after the card battles.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Platinum That-Was-Disgusting Box awarded
events.summary: Carl receives Platinum That-Was-Disgusting Box after the card battles.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Wand-casting
events.summary: The dungeon raises Carl’s wand-casting skill to five.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gold Wand Box
events.summary: Carl receives a Gold Wand Box for the wand achievement.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Wand Casting
events.summary: The wand achievement raises Carl’s wand-casting skill to level five.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gold Wand Box awarded
events.summary: Carl receives Gold Wand Box after the card battles.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Emergency Gold Benefactor Box awarded
events.summary: The Open Intellect Pacifist Network sends Carl an Emergency Gold Benefactor Box.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Liaison seizure overridden
events.summary: The attempted liaison seizure of Carl’s emergency benefactor box is overridden. He is instructed to open it privately.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Build Trench scrolls
events.summary: Carl receives Build Trench scrolls while opening his adventurer boxes.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Invisibility potions
events.summary: Carl receives Invisibility potions while opening his adventurer boxes.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Size-Up potion
events.summary: Carl receives Size-Up potion while opening his adventurer boxes.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Peanut oil
events.summary: The Gold Gobble Box contains peanut oil.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Printed recipes
events.summary: The Gold Gobble Box contains printed recipes.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Turkey deep fryer
events.summary: The Gold Gobble Box contains turkey deep fryer.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gold
events.summary: The hydra Boss Box contains 25,000 gold.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Warrior’s Gold Helmet of Resistance
events.summary: Carl receives the helmet but cannot use it: its Warrior restriction requires wielding a sword.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: The Shepherd’s House flyer
events.summary: The Emergency Gold Benefactor Box contains a flyer directing Carl to a shelter in Homestead at 7 AM.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Minor Find Crawler Skill potion
events.summary: The Platinum That-Was-Disgusting Box contains a potion granting Find Crawler level five if the drinker has not already reached it.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Minor Find Crawler Skill potion
events.summary: Carl immediately drinks the skill potion.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Find Crawler
events.summary: Drinking the potion grants Carl Find Crawler level five.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Book Burner patch
events.summary: The burning-book upgrade patch grants +15% Intelligence and Book Burner when attached to an eligible garment. Carl examines it; attachment is not stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Book Burner benefit
events.summary: The patch can suppress a named or last-cast spell for 30 hours once daily. Opponents above Carl’s level add a 5% failure chance per level. This is an item capability, not evidence of attachment or use.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Wand of Nighty-Night
events.summary: Carl stores the ten-charge wand. It casts level-ten Sleep for five minutes on one non-boss target; damage wakes the target and repeated casts compound the effect.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Majorette hat
events.summary: Donut opens the majorette hat Li Jun found on the previous floor. Its equipment state and effects are not stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Homestead map
events.summary: Carl takes a local map from a gas station while searching for the shelter.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Find Crawler
events.summary: Carl identifies Find Crawler as a level 5 skill.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Fan box received
events.summary: Carl receives a fan-box notification while inspecting the shelter. Its contents are not revealed yet.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Santa’s hat
events.summary: Donut messages that she found and kept the visiting Santa’s hat after the party.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Shelter resident’s storage tub
events.summary: Carl takes the red-hatted man’s sealed storage tub from the shelter. It belongs to the memory simulation and will vanish when the floor collapses.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sponsorship frozen
events.summary: Orren tells Carl that his Open Intellect Pacifist Network sponsorship slot has been frozen after its sponsors became fugitives.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Cracker Jack scroll
events.summary: Carl receives three Cracker Jack scrolls in exchange for the storage tub.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Shelter resident’s storage tub
events.summary: Carl trades the looted storage tub and its unexamined contents to Orren. Orren identifies Valtay enhancers and a communicator among the contents; Carl never consumes or equips them.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Wand recharge scroll
events.summary: Carl receives one wand recharge scroll in exchange for the storage tub.

events.subject: Party
events.name: Cretin contracts extended
events.summary: Orren permits Carl’s party to keep the four cretins in service for the duration of the ninth floor.

events.subject: Goff (Paulie)
events.name: Did not enter dungeon
events.summary: Orren says Goff’s human host Paulie appears to have been outside during the collapse and never entered the dungeon. This is an indirect report, not an observed death.

events.subject: Yasmine
events.name: Level
events.summary: The flashback identifies Yasmine, Club Vanquisher’s temple-portal secretary, as a level-75 Wisp and non-combatant. This is the later reveal of an earlier meeting.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Squad lost
events.summary: Imani’s totem kills four members of her squad. The system gives her four additional player-killer skulls.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Cracker Jack scroll
events.summary: Carl uses two of his three scrolls to unlock a shield for each party member.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition
events.summary: Carl unlocks his own Valtay shield.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Valtay Perso-Shield Platinum Edition
events.summary: Carl clips the unlocked shield to himself. It provides limited physical and corporeal-magic protection for roughly two minutes, with about an hour to recharge.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Bull Rush, Bespoke Personal Shield
events.summary: Carl attaches Donut’s unlocked shield pin to her collar.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Bull Rush, Bespoke Personal Shield
events.summary: Donut’s shield forms a moving bubble and can extend protection to Mongo or a vehicle at reduced strength.

events.subject: Dong Quixote
events.name: Lance
events.summary: Dong Quixote carries a lance while training. No magical bonus is stated.

events.subject: Author Steve Rowland
events.name: Club
events.summary: Steve Rowland uses a club while training with the mercenaries.

events.subject: Gluteus Maxx
events.name: Twin war gauntlets
events.summary: Gluteus Maxx uses twin war gauntlets to punch his training opponents.

events.subject: Bucket Boy
events.name: Healing
events.summary: Bucket Boy demonstrates healing during mercenary training, at an unspecified rank.

events.subject: Doctor Bones
events.name: Level
events.summary: Doctor Bones is a level-90 Skin Skellie Bard.

events.subject: Splash Zone
events.name: Water magic
events.summary: Splash Zone demonstrates powerful water magic during training; no named spell or rank is given.

events.subject: Doctor Bones
events.name: Grow flesh and organs
events.summary: As a Skin Skellie, Doctor Bones can grow temporary flesh and organs, making him vulnerable to additional damage and diseases.

events.subject: Doctor Bones
events.name: Conscript
events.summary: Doctor Bones uses Conscript to turn weak-minded opponents into lasting minions. His rank is not stated; the later reference to level 15 describes other factions’ targets, not his known rank.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Amhuluk totem
events.summary: Imani’s Amhuluk totem casts a poison cloud. This is the totem’s attack, not a native spell attributed to Imani.

events.subject: Randall
events.name: Group freeze
events.summary: Randall freezes himself and the other three members of Imani’s squad while trying to stop possession-driven fighting.

events.subject: Randall
events.name: Death
events.summary: Imani’s Amhuluk poisons Randall and the other three immobilized squad members, killing all four. Only Randall is named here.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Harley Davidson motorcycle
events.summary: Katia has tuned Carl’s salvaged motorcycle; he uses it to travel toward Imani.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Motorcycle Riding
events.summary: Carl’s motorcycle-riding skill reached level 9 during the return journey to the saferoom.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gasoline
events.summary: Carl confirms that he carries gasoline in his inventory for the motorcycle.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Located by Eye in the Sky
events.summary: An unidentified opponent uses Eye in the Sky at level 10 to pinpoint Carl’s location and level. Mordecai infers the rank from the notification’s behavior.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Trap disarming
events.summary: Imani successfully disables nail traps and a silent-alarm trap; no skill name or level is stated.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Poetry charm
events.summary: Samantha observes Ines reciting poetry from the head of a giant sea snake among gathered seals and crabs; Carl and Donut infer that the poetry is charming them.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Chowder War failed
events.summary: The Chowder War quest fails as demon possession overtakes the conflict; it is replaced by Hell Comes to Crawler Town.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Hell Comes to Crawler Town
events.summary: Carl must reach the stairs without being dragged into Sheol. The promised Legendary Quest Box and bagpipes are not yet awarded.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Traps deployed against demons
events.summary: Carl scatters traps, including previously looted demon-related traps, around the party before engaging Ines.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Robert’s sailor hat
events.summary: Donut switches back to the sailor hat before the card battle to reduce her draw cooldown.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Temporary Shield
events.summary: Donut’s active twenty-two-card deck includes Temporary Shield.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Lamp
events.summary: Donut’s active twenty-two-card deck includes Lamp.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Cripple
events.summary: Donut’s active twenty-two-card deck includes Cripple.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Steal Totem
events.summary: Donut’s active twenty-two-card deck includes Steal Totem.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Golden Combo
events.summary: Donut’s active twenty-two-card deck includes Golden Combo.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Sentient Staff Totem
events.summary: Donut’s active twenty-two-card deck includes Sentient Staff Totem.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Spell amplification (unnamed)
events.summary: Carl confirms that Samantha can amplify spells, after earlier failed attempts to elicit the ability. No formal skill name or level is supplied.

events.subject: Madre de Aguas
events.name: Level
events.summary: Madre de Aguas is a level-125 city boss.

events.subject: Madre de Aguas
events.name: Pre-zombism
events.summary: Zombie-fish bites infect Madre de Aguas with pre-zombism. She is still alive; she will turn undead if killed.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Book of Rhymes
events.summary: The announcers identify Ines’s newly granted patron skill Book of Rhymes at level 15; it amplifies Word Weaver.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Word Weaver
events.summary: Ines’s Nebular sponsors and patron helped raise Word Weaver to level 15, allowing control of the city boss and its creature-control powers.

events.subject: Yuguleth
events.name: Returned to Sheol
events.summary: Yuguleth drags a crab to Sheol and survives as his demon form when the seal shell burns away.

events.subject: Azireth
events.name: Level
events.summary: The freed demons, including the named Azireth whose abandoned shell Carl saw, are level-140 Petty Demon Pleasure Valets.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Ring of Strength +2
events.summary: Carl gives his original Strength ring to the jeweler to transform into the Pauper’s Ring; this earlier transaction is revealed in the flashback.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Emberus loan
events.summary: Carl pays 10,000 gold and borrows 990,000 interest-free from Emberus’s temple. He cannot renounce Emberus while the debt remains.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Cuts Both Ways cassette
events.summary: The Columbia House achievement awards Carl a cassette copy of Gloria Estefan’s Cuts Both Ways.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Enchanted Pauper’s Ring of the Steadfast Emberus
events.summary: Carl equips the transformed ring. It suppresses many disease and health-draining effects without removing the underlying debuffs, can overheat under too many debuffs, and curses non-worshippers with nearby debuffs.

effects.operation: Suppresses effects without removing debuffs; too many active debuffs can overwhelm ring
Inflicts all debuffs suffered within 50 meters if worn by a non-worshipper of Emberus

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Level
events.summary: Quan Ch has reached level 70.

events.subject: Nizzle
events.name: Demon shell destroyed
events.summary: Carl destroys the demon crab Nizzle’s shell with Talon Strike and kicks. The passage does not establish the ultimate fate of the underlying demon.

events.subject: Hoan Kiem
events.name: Level
events.summary: Hoan Kiem is a level-25 soft-shell turtle totem.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Hoan Kiem totem
events.summary: Quan summons his Common level-25 soft-shell turtle totem Hoan Kiem.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Force Play
events.summary: Quan consumes Force Play to make Ines play her Flee card after using Peekaboo to inspect her hand.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Flee card
events.summary: Quan forces Ines to consume a Flee card, removing her squad from the battle.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Cuba exit key
events.summary: Ines loses her exit key after the forced Flee; it goes to Quan as the remaining victorious deckmaster.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Super Spreader
events.summary: Carl casts Super Spreader on Quan immediately before the forced escape, infecting him with slugpox.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Hand exchanged
events.summary: Quan swaps three cards from his hand into Donut’s, leaving her with three Flee cards, then forces one to play.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Cuba exit key
events.summary: Donut’s squad loses its exit key to Quan after being forced to Flee.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Cuba exit keys
events.summary: Quan obtains both Donut’s and Ines’s exit keys after forcing both opponents to Flee.

events.subject: Khulan
events.name: Paralysis
events.summary: Carl recalls Khulan paralyzing targets for Ren’s flamethrower attacks; the ability’s rank is not given.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Acid Bath
events.summary: Samantha recalls using Acid Bath in her original divine body before her banishment. This is a historical ability, not a confirmed usable spell in her current head form.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Cannot independently teleport
events.summary: Samantha admits she cannot teleport others on her own. She can fly and amplify others’ spells, with unpredictable strength.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Two-part teleport trap sets
events.summary: Carl confirms that he has four two-part teleport trap sets before deploying their anchors.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Automaton Pilot
events.summary: Donut has Automaton Pilot at level 5, earned during the prior floor’s hunter battles. It allows her to attach some traps to robots, though not the two-part teleport traps.

events.subject: Chuluuna
events.name: See invisible
events.summary: Ren reports that Chuluuna can see the invisible Quan approaching the exit.

events.subject: Chuluuna
events.name: Stone skin
events.summary: Chuluuna’s Strength-focused class lets him turn his skin to stone and withstand Ren’s flamethrower.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Mobile teleport anchors deployed
events.summary: Samantha carries and releases trap-bearing spiders near the capitol exit, allowing Carl to trigger his matching trap and teleport to their location.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Spider automaton
events.summary: Carl crushes the first trap-bearing spider when he teleports onto it.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Trap setting
events.summary: Donut’s trap skill is level 3, allowing her to configure the Loop-De-Loop for crawlers outside her own party, with misfire risks.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Invisibility potion
events.summary: Carl drinks an invisibility potion before entering the capitol battle.

events.subject: Madre de Aguas
events.name: Dies and rises as undead
events.summary: Madre de Aguas dies from the zombism curse and rises undead, then becomes the shell through which Amayon enters the realm.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sheol fire conversion
events.summary: Amayon’s presence activates Scavenger’s Daughter, temporarily converting Carl’s fire spells into Sheol fire.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Platinum To Hell in a Handbasket Box
events.summary: Carl receives a Platinum To Hell in a Handbasket Box for witnessing Sheol royalty.

events.subject: Chuluuna
events.name: Chain Lightning
events.summary: Chuluuna casts Chain Lightning through Quan’s totems and Quan; the rank is not stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sticky hob-lobber
events.summary: Carl hits Quan’s head with a sticky hob-lobber, damaging his shields.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Basquiat totem
events.summary: Ren summons Basquiat, the Mongolian Death Worm.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Temporary Immortality
events.summary: Ren consumes Temporary Immortality on Basquiat before Quan exchanges control of the active totems.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Floor observation
events.summary: Garret is physically present with Tserendolgor late on Floor 8.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Floor observation
events.summary: Tserendolgor is physically present with Garret late on Floor 8.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Toss-Up
events.summary: Quan consumes Toss-Up to exchange his three weak totems for Ren’s two active totems, including the buffed death worm.

events.subject: Chuluuna
events.name: Death
events.summary: Ren’s former totem, now controlled by Quan, tears Chuluuna apart.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Gold-edition split summons
events.summary: Lazarus temporarily combined with Skylar Spinach splits on defeat into stronger Gold Edition Uzi Jesus and Lord of Blight summons. This is a battle-only split, not a permanent squad replacement.

events.subject: Jola
events.name: Fashion Critic
events.summary: Jola casts Fashion Critic, stripping Quan of everything he is wearing and disabling his worn protections.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Celestial cloak
events.summary: Quan’s clothes are stripped off during battle and Carl takes the magical cloak.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Celestial cloak
events.summary: Carl scoops up Quan’s stripped celestial cloak and stores it in inventory.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Sappy gold ring
events.summary: Carl identifies the personal ring Quan is asking to have returned. Possession has not transferred in this paragraph.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sappy gold ring
events.summary: Carl returns Quan’s pre-collapse For Daddy ring to his remaining hand.

events.subject: Quan Ch
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Carl confirms Quan Ch is dead after their battle.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Cuba exit keys
events.summary: Both keys transfer to Donut after she receives credit for Quan’s death.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Eye in the Sky scrolls
events.summary: Ren offers her supplies, including Eye in the Sky scrolls, to Carl. Their exact quantity is unstated.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Flamethrower
events.summary: Ren gives the flamethrower to Carl and reveals that its name is Velma.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Knife of Frozen Tears
events.summary: Ren draws and names the Knife of Frozen Tears, made from Sylvan crystal.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Capitol exit key
events.summary: The capitol exit collapses and its associated key is destroyed, leaving only the church key usable.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Regenerative death and reset
events.summary: Ren kills Garret with Sylvan crystal to trigger his fifth regeneration and reset him as an unnamed level-one pet. He does not remain dead.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Four weaknesses
events.summary: Before the reset, Garret is vulnerable to Sylvan crystal, consuming hobgoblin sweat, rivenwing bites, and consuming undead flesh.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Level reset
events.summary: After his fifth regenerative death, Garret resets to level 1 and loses his name and former bond.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Ownership change
events.summary: Tserendolgor places the reset pet in a carrier and transfers him to Carl.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Tummy acher pet carrier
events.summary: Carl accepts the carrier containing Ren’s reset level-one tummy acher pet.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Reaper Gaze weakness added
events.summary: After the reset Garret gains a fifth weakness, Reaper Gaze, in addition to his previous four.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Eye in the Sky scrolls
events.summary: Carl gathers Ren’s donated gear, which includes multiple Eye in the Sky scrolls. Their number and ranks are not stated here.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Velma flamethrower
events.summary: Carl collects Ren’s enchanted flamethrower/breastplate, named Velma, as she donates her gear.

events.subject: Khulan
events.name: Gear donated
events.summary: Khulan drops rings, potions, a glowing spear, armor, magical tomes and coins for Carl. The individual names and amounts are not given.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Glow-Up
events.summary: Carl accepts Ren’s unused consumable Glow-Up card, carrying it physically because cards cannot enter his inventory.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: The Midnight Express
events.summary: Carl accepts Ren’s unused consumable Special card The Midnight Express. Its effect has not yet been described.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Non-totem cards donated
events.summary: Ren gives Carl all non-totem cards from her deck. She cannot transfer the active totems.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Boomerang bowler hat
events.summary: Carl loots Quan’s throwing bowler hat, which can decapitate targets and return to its user.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Magical chainsaw
events.summary: Carl loots Quan’s magical chainsaw; no specific effect is described.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Nickel sock
events.summary: Carl loots a magically valuable sock filled with nickels from Quan.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Quan’s weapons looted
events.summary: Carl transfers Quan’s weapon collection and almost five million gold into his inventory, leaving the For Daddy ring on the corpse.

events.subject: Khulan
events.name: Presumed dead in collapse
events.summary: Khulan remains with Chuluuna’s body inside the capitol as Ren detonates her bracer and the building collapses. This scene does not independently confirm Khulan’s death.

events.subject: Tserendolgor
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: After her farewell and the building's collapse, Tserendolgor's name moves into the deceased-crawlers folder.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Golden player-killer skull
events.summary: Donut now bears a golden player-killer skull for receiving credit for Quan’s death.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Eye in the Sky scrolls
events.summary: Carl confirms that he now has five Eye in the Sky scrolls.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Pleasure demon minions
events.summary: Imani sees three level-140 pleasure demons inside the church identified as minions of Ines.

events.subject: Sister Ines Quiteria
events.name: Amayon compelled
events.summary: The demon prince inhabiting Madre de Aguas speaks under visible compulsion, supporting Donut’s conclusion that Ines is controlling him.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Shawl
events.summary: Samantha wears a shawl taken from a vendor booth.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Build Trench scrolls
events.summary: Carl reports receiving approximately fifty scrolls; this does not establish an exact remaining count.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Super Spreader
events.summary: Carl confirms he can use Super Spreader on one person per hour. No rank is stated.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Disease cured
events.summary: Imani cures the mercenaries of their slug-producing disease; the spell name and rank are unstated.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Five player-killer skulls
events.summary: Katia reports that Louis received his first five player-killer skulls from one attack. The victims are not named.

events.subject: Imani C.

events.summary: The system identifies Agatha as warlord of the newly recognized War Mage Rebellion; she obtains Conscription access and changes the defeat rules.

events.subject: Tuba
events.name: Survives conscription wound
events.summary: Tuba is saved from bleeding to death when defeating the Madness breaks her conscription. She is alive with Jamal’s group.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: War Mage Rebellion co-warlord
events.summary: Victory confirms Akuma is co-warlord of the War Mage Rebellion with Agatha, who has access to the warlord menu.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: You’re Not Done Yet
events.summary: Donut casts a tower-amplified You’re Not Done Yet on the deposited corpses, generating fleshers. No new spell rank is stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Hob-lobber
events.summary: Carl throws a full-strength hob-lobber at Nami’s flesher-covered body, destroying it and the attached creatures.

events.subject: Nami
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: After being ejected from Eris, Nami is consumed by fleshers. Carl destroys the resulting symbiote with a hob-lobber; animation of her body is not survival.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: Gate of the Feral Gods
events.summary: The war mage team trades the stolen Gate of the Feral Gods to a Midnight Market minion for five enhanced Conscription potions. Akuma was the last identified carrier.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: Hell-kissed Conscription potions
events.summary: The War Mage Rebellion obtains five level 18 hell-kissed Conscription potions in exchange for the Gate. Exact individual holders are not stated.
events.detail: Army acquisition; Akuma represents the last identified Gate carrier.

events.subject: Yarilo
events.name: Conscripted into the War Mage Rebellion
events.summary: Samantha reports a war mage successfully conscripts Yarilo with a potion, dying from the backlash. The mage is unnamed.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Fine Healing potion
events.summary: Carl throws a Fine Healing potion onto Rolling Battle Formation to keep the ball intact while the danger of conscripted gods is assessed.

events.subject: Li Jun
events.name: The Engine of Tomorrow
events.summary: Li Na recovers and installs Li Jun’s robotic eye after his death, so it no longer belongs to his equipped inventory.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: The Engine of Tomorrow
events.summary: Li Na installs her deceased brother’s robotic eye into herself. Her recovery of the eye is now explicit; the transfer occurred after his death.

events.subject: Derek Reilly
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: A flesher’s description states its skin came from Derek Reilly, who was already dead before the skin was removed. His original cause and time of death are not given.

events.subject: Selvi
events.name: Princess Posse member
events.summary: After the Madness falls, Selvi becomes an official Princess Posse member and follows Carl to Larracos.

events.subject: Tuba
events.name: Princess Posse member
events.summary: After being freed from Madness conscription, Tuba joins the Princess Posse and follows Carl to Larracos.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Pied Piper
events.summary: The Scavenger’s Daughter grants temporary level 15 Pied Piper while Carl is within Harpocrates’s presence.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Ghillie suit
events.summary: Donut wears a ghillie suit and is invisible atop the Nest while attempting to avoid Harpocrates. Exact item effects and source are not stated.

events.subject: Ferdinand
events.name: Bowler hat
events.summary: Ferdinand is again wearing the bowler hat Carl’s group traded to him at the start of the floor; the no-hat council observation did not mean permanent loss.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Dynastes form
events.summary: Juice Box appears as a large armored dynastes with scythes.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Alive but paralyzed and bound
events.summary: Carl verifies Louis is at full health but has Paralyzed and Bound statuses in the Reaver castle. His silence is not death.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Fleshmancer form possessed
events.summary: Juice Box confirms she has a fleshmancer form and promises Samantha a chosen body if Samantha rescues Louis. The promised body is not created yet.

events.subject: Toyotomi
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Toyotomi’s message reporting a woman and dog entering the Nest is marked as coming from a deceased mercenary.

events.subject: Bret S
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Sergeant Bret S’s plea for backup in the Nest is marked as coming from a deceased crawler.

events.subject: Bomo
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Bomo’s message that he will stop the intruder is marked as coming from a deceased mercenary.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Levitation potion
events.summary: Carl consumes his final Levitation potion to rise out of Larracos.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Cheese Cutters
events.summary: Carl drops two anti-personnel Cheese Cutters with the emergency bomb payload.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Dynamite
events.summary: Carl drops an uncounted large supply of dynamite from his emergency inventory folder.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Impact hob-lobbers
events.summary: Carl drops approximately 500 impact hob-lobbers in the emergency attack.
events.detail: Approximate quantity stated in text.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: No Disassemble EMP bombs
events.summary: Carl drops two No Disassemble bombs in the emergency attack.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: The Waffle Maker
events.summary: Carl dumps approximately 20 Waffle Makers from his emergency inventory folder toward the Piccadilly generator.
events.detail: Approximate quantity stated in text.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Smoke mantle
events.summary: Carl drops a smoke mantle while fleeing the city defense towers.

events.subject: Bomo
events.name: Regeneration expected on tenth floor
events.summary: Carl expects Bomo to regenerate on floor 10 despite the current confirmed death, but he no longer has the contract and does not know whether they will reunite. This is an expectation, not a current revival.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Enchanted Tooth Cap of Hi-Yo Silver
events.summary: Carl’s Hi-Yo Silver summon successfully pulls Rend to his former hiding place in Shanty Town.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Hell-kissed Conscription potion
events.summary: Li Na gives Carl a duplicated level 18 Hell-kissed Conscription potion recovered from a war mage. She retains the original.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Hell-kissed Conscription potion
events.summary: Li Na confirms she retained the original level 18 Conscription potion while giving the duplicate to Carl. Her planned use on Harpocrates is not yet shown.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Potion duplication scroll
events.summary: Li Na uses her deceased brother’s potion duplication scroll to copy the recovered Conscription potion for Carl.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sticky Feet
events.summary: Carl activates Sticky Feet to ascend the oil-covered converted ramp of the Nest.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Sleep potion barrel
events.summary: Donut uses a sleep-potion defensive barrel against Lucia; it fails to affect her.

events.subject: Raul
events.name: Level
events.summary: Donut summons Raul’s mythic-rarity card at level 110 for ten minutes. His prior-floor upgrade from 70 is reported retrospectively here.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Hell-kissed Conscription potion
events.summary: Carl smashes the duplicated level 18 Conscription potion onto Lucia’s head to stop Raul from killing her.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Protection spells cancelled
events.summary: Under Carl’s order Lucia cancels her active protection spells. This does not remove possession of the underlying abilities.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Tequila
events.summary: Lucia drinks tequila and attempts a fiery spit attack, but conscription prevents it from hitting Carl.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Conscripted into the Princess Posse
events.summary: The level 18 potion works and Lucia becomes a Princess Posse member, unable to attack Carl or deliberately harm his party.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Astral Paw
events.summary: Donut hits Gus with Astral Paw, pushing him down the Nest ramp; no new rank is stated.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Voice amplification
events.summary: Lucia uses a voice-amplification skill to call Gus. The actual ability name and rank are not given.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Anti-teleport binding scroll
events.summary: Lucia confirms she used a scroll to bind Donut to her room; teleporting while bound would make Donut explode. Lucia cannot voluntarily end it.

events.subject: Harpocrates
events.name: Level
events.summary: The system identifies Harpocrates as level 250 when he is conscripted into the Princess Posse.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Survives deity conscription
events.summary: Carl verifies Li Na remains alive at full health after successfully conscripting Harpocrates.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Ring of Divine Suffering
events.summary: Carl equips the Ring of Divine Suffering and begins marking Lucia but cancels the mark before it completes.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Yarilo patch benefit
events.summary: The Scavenger’s Daughter grants Carl temporary protection from all venereal diseases in Yarilo’s presence.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Clockwork Triplicate
events.summary: Donut’s Clockwork Triplicate creates two Mongo copies. One loses a leg; Gus destroys one and Harpocrates crushes the other. The real Mongo is separate.

events.subject: Harpocrates
events.name: Princess Posse White Dragons legionnaire
events.summary: Li Na successfully conscripts Harpocrates and commands him to fight Yarilo. He is a White Dragons legionnaire.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Fine Healing potion
events.summary: Carl consumes a Fine Healing potion after the gale tower folds his body during the dog fight.

events.subject: Gustavo 3
events.name: Porcupine Defense
events.summary: Gustavo 3 uses Porcupine Defense to impale Mongo with metal quills, then electrifies the quills. The ability rank is not given.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Wand of Nighty-Night
events.summary: A gale-tower blast destroys Carl’s sleep wand before he can use it on Gustavo 3.

events.subject: Gustavo 3
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Rend’s Wrecking Ball crushes through Gustavo 3, exploding the dog’s back half and ending the attack on Mongo.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Healing potion
events.summary: Carl downs another healing potion after Rend kills Gustavo 3; the exact quality is not stated.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Pet healing potion
events.summary: Lucia pours a pet healing potion on Mongo, who is barely alive with a torn throat.

events.subject: Mongo
events.name: Survives Gustavo3 attack
events.summary: Mongo remains alive with a tiny amount of health and receives Lucia’s pet healing potion; unconsciousness was not death.

events.subject: Florin
events.name: Nineteenth-century dictionary
events.summary: Florin has a large nineteenth-century dictionary with a bullet hole through most of its pages; it is now in the guildhall common room.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Removed for administrator interview
events.summary: Lucia is teleported away by administrators for an interview and is expected unavailable for at least an hour. She remains alive and conscripted.

events.subject: Yarilo
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Harpocrates kills Yarilo during their fight. The system confirms a deity has fallen and the Scavenger’s Daughter benefit from Yarilo fades.

events.subject: Agatha
events.name: Removed as War Mage Rebellion warlord
events.summary: The system removes Agatha as co-warlord for abandoning her post; Akuma becomes sole warlord with full access. This is not a death.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Level
events.summary: Carl confirms Donut is now level 74 after entering the Nest at 65. The earlier 65 is retrospective starting information, not a separate current reading.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Nest level gains
events.summary: Donut’s tower combat took her from 65 to 74. This describes the completed interval without inventing when each intermediate level occurred.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Magic Missile
events.summary: Donut reports that Magic Missile has reached level 15.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Rocket launcher
events.summary: Carl fires one of his last rocket launchers to destroy the gale tower attacking the Nest.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Anti-teleport room binding expires
events.summary: Lucia’s room-binding net expires and Donut is able to reach beyond the tower parapet again.

events.subject: Edgar
events.name: Tattoo kit
events.summary: Edgar brings his tattoo kit to the Nest to give Donut an urgently needed spell. The spell and completed tattoo are not revealed yet.

events.subject: Rosetta Thag
events.name: Pink razor
events.summary: Rosetta produces a pink disposable razor while preparing Donut’s tattoo.

events.subject: Katia Grim
events.name: Enemy-pulling spell mentioned again
events.summary: The narrator confirms Katia has an enemy-pulling spell, written as Hamzo here. The earlier award used the spelling Hanzo. Neither passage gives a rank.

events.subject: Katia Grim
events.name: Hamzo
events.summary: Carl explicitly names Katia’s enemy-pulling and stunning spell Hamzo. It was considered for Donut’s plan but rejected for insufficient area; Katia’s possession is confirmed.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: War Crime
events.summary: The spell description confirms War Crime currently starts at level 5 and has never been cast. It combines two spells of at least rank 8 and can only be cast once per eligible floor, three times total.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: War Crime restrictions
events.summary: War Crime reduces the caster to 1 percent health and locks the selected spells for the rest of the floor. It cannot directly kill its targets, requiring a separate finishing attack.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Crupper
events.summary: Donut removes her crupper for the tattoo. The exact crupper variant is not named in this passage.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Ghillie suit
events.summary: Donut removes her ghillie suit to allow preparation of the spell tattoo.

events.subject: Edgar
events.name: Fallen-crawler spell tattoo technique
events.summary: Edgar explains his new ink technique, developed with Milk, preserves a fallen crawler’s skill or spell. Donut’s tattoo is being prepared, not completed by chapter end.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Stolen catalytic converter
events.summary: Donut receives a stolen catalytic converter as an achievement prize when the dog tattoo is completed.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Bijanbi
events.summary: Donut gains Bijanbi at level 2 through Edgar’s fallen-cleric tattoo. The spell comes from worship of Wepwawet, but she does not choose to worship that god here.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Bijanbi
events.summary: Milk’s Words of Power temporarily amplify the tattoo-granted Bijanbi to level 15; the extra power will fade with the ink.

events.subject: Milk
events.name: Stayfast Ink
events.summary: Milk gives Carl 825 ml of Stayfast Ink, which is described as permanent despite distance, time or the death of a star.
events.detail: Quantity in milliliters.

events.subject: Milk
events.name: Adept’s fountain pen
events.summary: Milk gives Carl an Adept’s fountain pen.

events.subject: Rosetta Thag
events.name: Feather Fall potion
events.summary: Rosetta consumes a Feather Fall potion before jumping from the Nest carrying Edgar.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Mordecai’s Special Brew
events.summary: Donut confirms she has Mordecai’s Special Brew in her hotlist as a survival contingency. She has not consumed it yet.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Hover
events.summary: Donut confirms she possesses Hover for escaping a falling tower. The current rank is not stated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Benefactor Box received
events.summary: Donut reveals she received a Benefactor Box while Carl was not watching. The contents are not disclosed yet.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Power Siphon
events.summary: The adjutants identify Lucia’s Power Siphon ability, which draws energy from active Larracos towers to power a delayed secondary containment net.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Enchanted sunglasses
events.summary: Donut equips her sunglasses and uses their energy-flow view to locate the Power Siphon trigger; this is distinct from their heat mode.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: New class and Champion title
events.summary: Casting War Crime grants Donut a new class and the title The Oak Fell, Champion of Nekhebit. The class’s actual name is not given yet.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Pied Piper
events.summary: Eris permanently grants Carl the previously temporary level 15 Pied Piper benefit from Harpocrates. The losing wheel option is not applied permanently.

events.subject: Eris
events.name: Level
events.summary: The system identifies the now-unsponsored goddess Eris as level 250.

events.subject: Britney
events.name: Possessed after taking an axe
events.summary: Eris tells Carl Britney picked up an axe and is now possessed. The possessing entity is not named yet; this is not a death.

events.subject: Paca
events.name: Gate of the Feral Gods
events.summary: Eris identifies Paca as the Midnight Market merchant who received the Gate of the Feral Gods; she keeps it in her stomach and is an agent of Krakaren Prime.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Healing potion
events.summary: Carl consumes a healing potion after Eris breaks his finger during the frozen encounter.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Healing scroll
events.summary: Carl successfully consumes the healing scroll to restore Donut’s health after the War Crime drain. His earlier attempt misfired during the casting.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: War Crime
events.summary: Donut’s first War Crime combines Bijanbi and Astral Paw. The recruited targets are suspended under an enormous paw, then driven into Li Na’s chain lattice. The casting itself cannot directly kill.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Chain-lattice finisher
events.summary: Li Na creates and continually renews a lattice of chains between the towers, cutting the targets Donut strikes down through it. The exact skill name and rank are not stated.

events.subject: Meatus
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: The system confirms Meatus has been chopped apart across the battlefield and removes his patch effect. Harpocrates mourns the loss.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Party leadership
events.summary: Donut confirms she has regained party leadership.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Oak Fell additional class confirmed
events.summary: Donut confirms Oak Fell is an additional class rather than a replacement: Former Child Actor benefits remain. Champion status permits worship only within Nekhebit’s court, without requiring worship.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Two Celestial boxes awarded
events.summary: Donut receives two more Celestial boxes and a Lorena Bobbitt achievement after the War Crime attack. Contents are not opened here.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Strength and Intelligence thresholds
events.summary: Mordecai confirms Donut passed the 100-point threshold for both Strength and Intelligence. These values mark the thresholds for choosing stat benefits; the exact totals are unstated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Charisma threshold
events.summary: Donut confirms crossing the 200-point Charisma threshold for a stat benefit. The exact total is unstated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Brain Trust
events.summary: Donut selects Brain Trust as her intelligence-threshold benefit to strengthen Magic Missile. Its numeric effect and rank are not given.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Love Vampire
events.summary: Mordecai confirms Donut’s Love Vampire ability and charm are now extremelypowerful; exactrank and effecttotal are not stated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Wholesale Discount
events.summary: Donut selects Wholesale Discount for the 200 charisma threshold and confirms she can buy storegoods at cost.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Character level
events.summary: Carl is explicitly confirmed at level 81.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Level
events.summary: Carl examines Donut and confirms she has reached level 135 after the War Crime attack.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Muscle Mommy
events.summary: Donut selects Muscle Mommy after crossing the strength threshold; it grants Mongo bonusstrength equal to 25 percent of her own.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Strength
events.summary: The system identifies Li Na’s base Strength as 300.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: INT base observation
events.summary: The system announces that Li Na has reached 300 base Intelligence.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: CHA confirmation
events.summary: The system confirms Li Na has maxed every base stat, explicitly including charisma. The cap is 300.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Inferred capped Dexterity and Constitution
events.summary: The system reports that every base stat is capped and gives 300 for Strength and Intelligence. Applying that cap yields 300 each for Dexterity and Constitution. Those two metrics are not individually numbered in the announcement.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Level
events.summary: Donut explicitly reports Li Na at level 87 after the battle. The preceding level-84 observation is no longer the latest known level.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Boosted charisma above 300
events.summary: Donut reports more than 300 CHA. Carl clarifies that her base has not reached 300.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Character level
events.summary: Prepotente is explicitly confirmed at level 100.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Ring of Divine Suffering
events.summary: Carl realizes Li Na had already marked the enemies in the ball using the Ringof Divine Suffering. Several markedtargets survived, preventing her from healing. The ring is actively equipped here.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: Leaves with the Scavenger’s Daughter
events.summary: Akuma reports the war mages found the Scavenger’s Daughter within the castle and left with her. Her individual identity and condition are not yet explained.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: Leaves the realm
events.summary: Akuma leaves the realm and the War Mage Rebellion is defeated with no assets. The system does not say he dies; departure must not become a death marker.

events.subject: Heidi
events.name: Pregnant wife missing on entry
events.summary: Florin says Jurgen entered with his pregnant wife Heidi, who disappeared. He believes she is in the surface kinder facility. Her current fate is not independently confirmed.

events.subject: Big Tina
events.name: Ever-repairing feather boa
events.summary: Big Tina wears a magical self-repairing feather boa, now scorched after she destroyed a fire-lance tower and protected crawlers.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Flight
events.summary: Prepotente reports Li Na can now fly. He guesses it is a dexterity benefit; the source and exact ability name are not confirmed.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: New hunting abilities reported
events.summary: Prepotente says Li Na appears to have new hunting skills but cannot find every marked survivor. Exact names and ranks are not given.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Memorial Crystal: Apito
events.summary: A quest update confirms that Prepotente now possesses the crystal previously held by Osvaldo.

events.subject: Osvaldo
events.name: Memorial Crystal: Apito
events.summary: A quest update explicitly reports that the crystal has passed from Osvaldo to Prepotente.

events.subject: Bautista
events.name: Reaver assault procession
events.summary: Bautista drives the carriage carrying Carl, Imani, and Katia in the assault procession.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Reaver assault procession
events.summary: Carl travels with Imani, Katia, Bautista, Donut, Mongo, and the assault procession toward the Reaver castle.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Reaver assault procession
events.summary: Imani travels with Carl, Katia, Bautista, Donut, Mongo, and the assault procession.

events.subject: Katia Grim
events.name: Reaver assault procession
events.summary: Katia travels with Carl, Imani, Bautista, Donut, Mongo, and the assault procession.

events.subject: Mongo
events.name: Reaver assault procession
events.summary: Mongo carries Donut alongside Carl, Imani, Katia, Bautista, and the assault procession.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Reaver assault procession
events.summary: Donut rides Mongo alongside Carl, Imani, Katia, Bautista, and the assault procession.

events.subject: Dong Quixote
events.name: Twinkle Toes
events.summary: Dong actively uses Twinkle Toes on Gonk to keep pace with the transport.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Gather Ye, Vermin
events.summary: Donut’s Oak Fell class grants Gather Ye Vermin, drawing mammals under a certain size from within ten kilometers.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Raise Forest
events.summary: Donut’s Oak Fell class grants Raise Forest, creating plants and trees across one kilometer per spell level. Her current spell rank is not stated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Salt-water transformation spell
events.summary: Donut gains an Oak Fell spell that turns water into salt water. The exact spell name and rank are not provided.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Pied Piper function clarified
events.summary: Carl explains Pied Piper lets him play musical instruments; it has no rodent-control effect.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Bagpipes
events.summary: Carl confirms bagpipes remain in his rarely-needed inventory folder.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Bea Arthur condom
events.summary: Carl confirms the Bea Arthur novelty condom remains in his rarely-needed inventory folder.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sushi-making kit
events.summary: Carl confirms the sushi-making kit remains in his rarely-needed inventory folder.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Map the All Tree
events.summary: Donut gains Map The All Tree from Oak Fell. It maps the tree and nodes, costs one mana and only functions on floor 12 or deeper; she cannot use it on this floor.

events.subject: Calliope
events.name: Level
events.summary: Calliope, Warlord Fang’s cybernetic bleached-drake pet, is level 130.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Hunter Wraith form
events.summary: Juice Box transforms into a Hunter Wraith.

events.subject: Doctor Bones
events.name: Reaver castle paper map
events.summary: Doctor Bones produces a paper map of the Reaver castle so Carl can mark Louis and Samantha’s locations.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Teleport escape items
events.summary: Carl confirms Juice Box has two teleport items, including one keyed to the rescue transport platform.

events.subject: Bautista
events.name: Stuffed animals
events.summary: Bautista sends stuffed animals into the moving honeycomb passages to scout routes; the toy variants and count are not given.

events.subject: Kiwi
events.name: Labor begins
events.summary: Kiwi’s water breaks and she enters active labor in Bucket Boy’s clinic. Births have not occurred yet.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Buster
events.summary: Samantha identifies a robot security dog she calls Buster and says she removed its lower jaw and explosive part. She wants to keep it as a pet, but successful retrieval is not confirmed.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Brain Trust spell-level effect
events.summary: Brain Trust makes Donut’s spells operate one full level higher. Magic Missile trained 15 therefore operates at 16; the effective 16 is already recorded separately.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Magic Missile
events.summary: Brain Trust raises the casting strength to 16 while the spell’s own rank remains 15.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Frozen Ditch Digger sentry dog
events.summary: Carl collects a large Reaver sentry dog frozen by Elle, including its attached Mini Tactical Nuke, into inventory before it can detonate.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Blast shield
events.summary: Carl deploys a blast shield while retreating from the nuclear robot dogs.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Fine Healing potion
events.summary: Carl consumes a Fine Healingpotion after a Heal cast following theblast.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Healing potion
events.summary: Carl consumes a healing potion while rolling from theblast, then casts Heal and consumes a Fine Healingpotion to restore his hearing.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Group shield
events.summary: Imani protects Elle, Holger, and others with a shield unfamiliar to Carl.
events.detail: Descriptive label; formal ability name unknown.

events.subject: Jamal
events.name: Replacement automaton legs
events.summary: The No Disassemble EMP wrecks Jamal’s mechanicallegs, leaving himflopping on theground. Jamal himself remainsalive.

events.subject: Calliope
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Calliope falls from thesky andexplodes after thecastle’s nuclear chainreaction; thetext explicitly calls this thedrake’s death.

events.subject: Juice Box
events.name: Possession (Hunter Wraith)
events.summary: A system message confirms Juice Box controls Louis through wraith possession. This ability is demonstrated in Hunter Wraith form; no skill level is stated.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: No Disassemble EMP bombs
events.summary: Juice Box, possessing Louis, drops his recovered EMPbombs inside thecastle before teleporting him out; Carl triggers them remotely.

events.subject: Warlord Fang
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: The system confirms Fang died while hiding inside Calliope; thebomb chainreaction is credited chiefly to Carl with Louis and Juice Box sharingexperience.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Mechanical heart and lungs
events.summary: Juice Box discovers Louis’s heart andlungs were surgicallyreplaced by mechanicalorgans containing livingpieces of Tagg. Louis remainsalive; no statbonus isstated.
