events.subject: Gonk
events.name: Guild stables
events.summary: Imani confirms Gonk is in the guild pet stables with Simoom.

events.subject: Simoom
events.name: Guild stables
events.summary: Imani confirms Simoom remains in the guild pet stables with Gonk, rather than departing to floor twelve.

events.subject: Garret
events.name: Returned to carrier
events.summary: Carl puts Rend in his carrier to keep him away from potatoes and other hazards.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Jikininki mercenaries hired
events.summary: Rosetta returns with two level-25 Jikininki ghouls hired as mercenaries. Both are unnamed; no invented individual roster entries.

events.subject: Katia Grim
events.name: Surface contact reported
events.summary: Lexis reports OIAN has contacted Katia at the South Asian kinder facility and believes she is okay. Information is limited; the facility has not been recaptured by OIAN.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: War Crime unavailable until floor twelve
events.summary: Donut confirms she cannot cast War Crime again before the twelfth floor. No second cast or new combination occurs here.

events.subject: Katia Grim
events.name: Kinder facility protected by a deity
events.summary: Orren confirms a dungeon deity has manifested at the kinder facility with Katia, but says it is not Eileithyia. The deity’s identity is still unstated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Midnight Epicure patch
events.summary: Carl confirms the Midnight Epicure patch is still attached to his jacket. No new bonus value is given.

events.subject: Harbinger
events.name: Pulse rifle
events.summary: Harbinger arrives carrying an enormous pulse rifle and later aims it at Carl. He does not fire.

events.subject: Harbinger
events.name: Killed by the AI
events.summary: Harbinger physically explodes when the AI intervenes as he aims at Carl. He is present in person, unlike the holographic caprid guests.

events.subject: Lexis
events.name: Concealed pistol
events.summary: Lexis draws a pistol during the confrontation, does not fire, and returns it to a hidden back holster.

events.subject: Gluteus Maxx
events.name: Gauntlets
events.summary: Gluteus removes his gauntlets before driving.

events.subject: Gluteus Maxx
events.name: Hockey helmet
events.summary: Gluteus borrows and wears a hockey helmet from discarded equipment.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Smart Companion Royal Pet Throne
events.summary: Donut occupies the installed Ultimate Diamond Pampered Pet Princess edition throne, named Dorota. It provides a gyroscopic cushioned bed, vital monitoring and snacks; unspecified stress relief is not yet interpreted.

events.subject: Gluteus Maxx
events.name: Outworlder uppers
events.summary: Gluteus reports taking two stimulant pills found by Samantha in Rishi’s fan-box junk before driving.

events.subject: Samantha
events.name: Outworlder uppers
events.summary: Gluteus reveals Samantha has been taking these stimulants to win at Mario Kart. Quantity is unknown.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Laundry Day
events.summary: Princess Donut is confirmed to have Laundry Day.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Defensive cage system
events.summary: Hedy constructs and installs deployable twin cage arms inside the food truck for its ghoul defenders.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Denial of Service missiles
events.summary: Carl fires eight missiles, four toward One Fine Pig and four toward Sparkles. Their payload coats targets in sight-blocking mucus rather than an explosive blast.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Biscuit Packs deployed
events.summary: The hired ghoul throws Biscuit Pack potion balls that expand into rapidly hardening foam barriers. Exact supply and consumption counts are unstated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Wall of Fire
events.summary: Donut casts Wall of Fire at effective level 16 after the stated level 15 is powered up.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Wall of Fire
events.summary: Donut casts Wall of Fire, described as level 15 powered up to effective 16. The source does not say the underlying 15 is unmodified training.

events.subject: Tem
events.name: Killed by Odette
events.summary: The system identifies the race obstacle as Tem’s skull and reports Odette killed him shortly after he emerged from the Nothing, a few days earlier.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Temporary Macaroni
events.summary: Donut’s level-14 Temporary Macaroni is explicitly enhanced to effective level 15.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Temporary Macaroni
events.summary: Donut has acquired and cast Temporary Macaroni; its supplied casting level is 14, before enhancement.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Bang Bro
events.summary: Carl casts Bang Bro to electrify his gauntlet and kill an attached Sugar Hermit. No rank is stated.

events.subject: Chiyome
events.name: Killed during third race
events.summary: Carl’s message to Chiyome is rejected because she is deceased; the system confirms every Wild Hunt team member has died.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Jugglers eliminated
events.summary: The system confirms the Jugglers have been eliminated because all team members are dead. Their individual names are not provided.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Throne defensive arms
events.summary: Dorota deploys multiple arms and tears a Sugar Hermit off Donut’s face, revealing an active defensive function.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Foot protection expired
events.summary: Carl confirms his foot-protection buff has expired while he is trapped in the costume.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Daughter’s Kiss
events.summary: Carl activates Daughter’s Kiss before striking the giant skull obstacle with his feet. No rank is stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Healing scroll
events.summary: Carl’s programmed health contingency automatically activates a healing scroll after the crash.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Fine Healing potion
events.summary: Carl drinks two Fine Healing potions after the crash to heal multiple fractures.

events.subject: Corcunda
events.name: Survives third-race crash
events.summary: Corcunda remains unconscious and his containment suit tears, but the narration explicitly confirms he is still alive.

events.subject: Rapture
events.name: Healing potion
events.summary: Rapture administers an unspecified healing potion to the badly injured Genesis after the crash.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Third-race victory
events.summary: The Royal Court of Princess Donut is awarded first place in the third heat despite the destroyed food truck.

events.subject: Old Shuck
events.name: Survives Jugglers elimination
events.summary: Old Shuck walks over the finish line alive after his riders die, then disappears from the race. Removal is not death.

events.subject: Onikuma
events.name: Survives Wild Hunt elimination
events.summary: Onikuma walks over the finish line alive after his riders die, then disappears from the race. Removal is not death.

events.subject: Dr. Metcalf
events.name: Survives truck destruction
events.summary: The damaged GPS unit remains active and speaks from the wreckage while the truck is being rebuilt.

events.subject: Sammi Harrison
events.name: Fire truck
events.summary: Sammi Harrison’s crawler team uses a fire truck and survives into the next race.

events.subject: Sammi Harrison
events.name: Isopod summoner
events.summary: Zhang identifies Sammi Harrison as an isopod summoner who helped defend the FUPA. No numeric skill rank is stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Enchanted Juvenile Macropus Dominus Skin
events.summary: The timed kangaroo costume is gone; Carl can resume his foot routine.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Jump
events.summary: The costume-granted Jump skill ends when the costume is gone.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Lotion Application
events.summary: The costume-granted five-level bonus ends; no permanent trained total is inferred.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Foot buff restored
events.summary: After the costume expires, Carl performs his foot routine and resets his protection buff.

events.subject: Jamal
events.name: Grabber hands installed
events.summary: Mordecai designs new grabbers on Jamal’s front mechanical legs; Jamal uses them to brush Carl and Donut, renewing their daily buffs.

events.subject: Gluteus Maxx
events.name: Recovering from overdose
events.summary: Gluteus is conscious and recovering on the couch after the stimulant overdose and race crash.

events.subject: Helado
events.name: Killed in an earlier race
events.summary: Olga reports the chain-wielding female demon killed their teammate Helado during a prior heat. His exact class and level are unstated.

events.subject: Olga
events.name: Level
events.summary: Olga is the level-75 Grulke frog member of hired mercenary team Helix.

events.subject: Finley
events.name: Level
events.summary: Finley is the level-81 Porsuk member of hired mercenary team Helix.

events.subject: Finley
events.name: Enchanted claws
events.summary: Finley’s claws glow green with an enchantment; the exact poison effect is inferred by Carl, not confirmed numerically.

events.subject: Quemada
events.name: Level
events.summary: Quemada is the level-96 fire fairy on hired team Helix; she worships Emberus.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Helix mercenaries hired
events.summary: Carl agrees to hire Olga, Finley and Quemada at the demanded triple price. Finley and Olga can drive; Quemada is assigned defense.

events.subject: Olga
events.name: Toad clarification
events.summary: Olga corrects Donut: she identifies herself as a toad, not a frog.

events.subject: Eris
events.name: Level
events.summary: Eris is displayed at level 251, one higher than Carl previously saw. She is unsponsored and invulnerable on this floor.

events.subject: Eris
events.name: Robot Uzi Jesus
events.summary: Eris has a small robot Uzi Jesus as a pet, carrying a toy Uzi. It is not the original summoned Uzi Jesus.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Munificent Goddess Kina
events.summary: Donut is still wearing the kneepads received from Katia, allowing her to detect Eris entering the realm.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Eris palm mark
events.summary: Carl catches Eris’s five-sided coin; it dissolves and leaves a moving swirl tattoo on his palm. Neither the system nor Eris supplies a definite effect. Predicted deaths and mutilations are possibilities, not events.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Jacobus permanently summoned
events.summary: The Eris-triggered Scavenger’s Daughter effect permanently summons Imani’s Jacobus and removes his use as a card. This is the newly revealed target of the earlier random permanence effect.

events.subject: Jacobus
events.name: Level
events.summary: Jacobus, the Reverse Tooth Fairy, is displayed at level 90 after being permanently summoned from Imani’s Legendary card.

events.subject: Jacobus
events.name: Permanent companion
events.summary: Jacobus is now permanently present with Imani rather than limited by his former short card-summon duration.

events.subject: Hickster
events.name: Killed by Akuma
events.summary: Hickster’s corpse identifies him as a level 25 upgrade imp killed by Akuma. His corpse metadata is not a new living character-level measurement.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Akuma’s kiddie-menu note
events.summary: Carl loots the note left on Hickster’s corpse, demanding he return alone.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Disintegration trap module
events.summary: Carl detects, disarms and loots the disintegration trap attached to the hidden door.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: War mage heads
events.summary: Carl confirms multiple war mage heads remain in his inventory. Exact number is unstated.

events.subject: Elle McGib
events.name: Ice Bolt
events.summary: Elle casts an ice bolt at Akuma; the spell level is not stated.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Mute
events.summary: Donut casts Mute on Akuma before the interrogation. No rank is supplied.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Anti-magic protection
events.summary: Imani is directed to cast an anti-magic shield during the interrogation; no formal spell name or level is stated.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Frozen war mage tissue
events.summary: Prepotente collects the frozen tissue fragments from Akuma’s injury in a glass beaker. No useful effect is established.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Anti-magic shield active
events.summary: Akuma’s health drains inside the anti-magic shield, confirming the previously instructed protection is now active.

events.subject: Herot
events.name: Alive in Pineapple Cabaret
events.summary: Akuma identifies Herot, the skink author of cookbook edition sixteen, as still alive and maintaining the Pineapple Cabaret.

events.subject: Menerva
events.name: Pineapple Cabaret co-creator
events.summary: Akuma identifies former crawler Menerva as Herot’s partner in creating the Cabaret and seventeenth-floor front. This is reported information, not a numeric character update.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: Five war mages remain
events.summary: Akuma says only five of his war mages survive after Faction Wars. He is alive during this interrogation; the unnamed dead cannot be individually attributed.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Cabaret entry restriction
events.summary: Akuma says god-worshippers cannot enter the Cabaret safely because entry triggers a smite. Casino and shop-interface access are proposed routes, not completed travel.

events.subject: Akuma
events.name: Added to Carl’s chat
events.summary: Akuma survives interrogation at roughly two percent health; a fist bump adds him to Carl’s chat while they share a floor.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Flavored sodas
events.summary: Prepotente picks up approximately two hundred sodas in glasses with straws. Each variety has a different unspecified buff.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Strawberry milkshake
events.summary: Louis drinks the milkshake ordered from the labeled menu, which states a five-percent reaction-time bonus. Its effect makes his expelled gill water red and strawberry-scented.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Temporary Constitution bonus
events.summary: Carl drinks the beer and receives its temporary Constitution buff: two percent for the next race. This is not a base-stat increase.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Fleshmancer hired
events.summary: Imani hires an unnamed human fleshmancer as a mercenary and plans to keep him hidden in the guild until needed.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Singing guild entry rejected
events.summary: Attempts guild entry using a Journey song without Auto-Tune; the gauge does not move and she does not gain entrance.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Race truck upgrades
events.summary: Three new race-truck upgrades are active: an anti-flip gyro, an electrifiable Bubble Buddy knockoff shield, and resizable all-terrain tires. Floating remains a future upgrade, not yet granted.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Survival containment
events.summary: An indestructible survival-containment bubble activates around the race truck to protect occupants from the heat’s toxic air; it does not block spells or projectiles.

events.subject: Bruna
events.name: Team Flamengo mount
events.summary: Bruna is Osvaldo and Filipe’s armored six-legged Slaughter Gnu race mount, wearing an enchanted spiked double saddle. Her mount status protects her from most ordinary mount-affecting spells.

events.subject: Osvaldo
events.name: Character level
events.summary: Osvaldo is explicitly observed at level 72.

events.subject: Osvaldo
events.name: Roster relationship
events.summary: Osvaldo is known as recurring crawler.

events.subject: Filipe L
events.name: Level
events.summary: Filipe L is a level 63 human Strongman and drives Bruna.

events.subject: Gimli
events.name: Death recalled
events.summary: Carl recalls Osvaldo’s pet stone hawk Gimli dying at the end of the Butcher’s Masquerade, killed by Prepotente or probably Bianca. The exact killer is uncertain and the event predates this reveal.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Memorial crystal of Apito
events.summary: Now holds Apito’s memorial crystal, taken from Osvaldo during the end of Faction Wars. Carl does not know how he stole it.

events.subject: Filipe L
events.name: Tupa worship
events.summary: Worships the deity Tupa, excluding him from the non-worshippers’ Pineapple Cabaret route.

events.subject: Osvaldo
events.name: Tupa worship
events.summary: Worships the deity Tupa, excluding him from the non-worshippers’ Pineapple Cabaret route.

events.subject: Olga
events.name: Bubble shield
events.summary: Activates the truck’s new shield to stop acid rain. It matches the survival-containment size but is a separate protective system.

events.subject: Osvaldo
events.name: Ysalte memorial crystal
events.summary: Reports finding a second memorial crystal during Faction Wars. Tupa rejected both it and Apito’s as corrupted; his current quest is to discover why they do not work.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Apito crystal gift clarified
events.summary: Osvaldo says he voluntarily gave Apito’s crystal to Prepotente after finding the second crystal. This corrects Carl’s earlier belief that it was stolen.

events.subject: Ysalte
events.name: Earlier death recalled
events.summary: Osvaldo identifies his second crystal as belonging to Ysalte, previously killed by Paz. This is retrospective corroboration, not a new death occurrence.

events.subject: Bruna
events.name: Survival after attack
events.summary: Recovers after Team Sparkles’ gun knocks her over. Osvaldo confirms the team is okay.

events.subject: Helado
events.name: Death recalled
events.summary: Olga reports their ice-fairy companion Helado was killed by the chain demon. Quemada killed one unnamed client during the resulting panic; no victim name is given.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Torch
events.summary: Casts Torch when the truck enters the dark jungle.

events.subject: Finley
events.name: Induced sleep
events.summary: Pokes Quemada with a claw and makes her unconscious to interrupt her panic. No ability name or rank is stated.

events.subject: Quemada
events.name: Unconscious
events.summary: Finley induces unconsciousness and places her in the truck’s sink. This is not a death.

events.subject: Henrietta
events.name: Death reported
events.summary: Imani reports Henrietta’s race mount was swallowed by a trap and Henrietta and her partner are gone. The partner is unnamed.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Wall-climbing kit
events.summary: Her team has a wall-climbing and descending kit for the course cliff, though deployment is slow.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Astral Paw
events.summary: Princess Donut is confirmed to have Astral Paw.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Dog tattoo
events.summary: Reports her dog tattoo biting her after the Astral Paw cast; its precise trigger/effect is not explained here.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Mind Balance
events.summary: Mind Balance negates Great Rusty’s Soul Suck. No rank is stated.

events.subject: Great Rusty
events.name: Level
events.summary: Great Rusty, Cannibal Ginger Chieftain, is examined as a level 99 neighborhood boss.

events.subject: Olga
events.name: Gingered
events.summary: Soul Suck applies Gingered, rendering Olga unconscious and draining her health.

events.subject: Great Rusty
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Donut’s Magic Missile kills Great Rusty instantly. His corpse is then run over.

events.subject: Olga
events.name: Soul returned but impaired
events.summary: Wakes after Great Rusty dies; health stops draining, but Gingered and a fugue remain until specialized cleric healing. She is alive.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Pasty Inferno quest
events.summary: Great Rusty’s death triggers a mandatory quest to kill northern chieftain Maurice before the race can be finished. No reward has yet been received.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Fresh into Salt
events.summary: Donut uses Fresh into Salt, granted by her Champion of Nekhebit title.

events.subject: Jamal
events.name: Improved sticky feet
events.summary: His upgraded legs let him stick to the garage ceiling. He is physically able to move but frightened of the height.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Hover
events.summary: Princess Donut is confirmed to have Hover.

events.subject: Finley
events.name: Scorched carrying patch
events.summary: Has a thick scorched-leather patch and strap on his jacket, apparently for carrying the unconscious fire fairy.

events.subject: Finley
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Team One Fine Pig’s APV runs over Finley carrying Olga and Quemada, reverses and crushes them again. The mercenary death notification explicitly confirms this victim.

events.subject: Olga
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Team One Fine Pig’s APV runs over Finley carrying Olga and Quemada, reverses and crushes them again. The mercenary death notification explicitly confirms this victim.

events.subject: Quemada
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Team One Fine Pig’s APV runs over Finley carrying Olga and Quemada, reverses and crushes them again. The mercenary death notification explicitly confirms this victim.

events.subject: Nico
events.name: APV ethereal gun
events.summary: Team One Fine Pig’s APV deploys a non-corporeal blue side gun and fires a blast that destroys walls and flips the neighboring double-decker bus.

events.subject: Elle McGib
events.name: Ice encasement
events.summary: Encases the burning double-decker bus in ice, stopping the fire. The spell’s formal name and rank are not stated.

events.subject: Lipstick
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: The One Fine Pig APV’s activated shield crushes its gremlin Lipstick against the garage back wall, killing him.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Mercenary corpses
events.summary: At Carl’s request collects Finley and Olga’s corpses and the unnamed camel’s body. Quemada has vanished in a flare, leaving no stored corpse.

events.subject: Bodi
events.name: Food buffs boost race vehicle
events.summary: Louis reports Bodi ate from many Hungry Eyes stalls before the heat; his resulting buffs greatly increase the speed of the team’s lowrider Eileen. No numerical buffs are specified.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: All Eyes on Me
events.summary: Donut’s high charisma allows All Eyes on Me to work with speech instead of singing; no stat total is given.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Tigran-targeted disintegration traps
events.summary: Places two silent single-target disintegration traps beside the APV and programs them to activate only for Tigrans, sparing Penelope.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Protective secretions
events.summary: Louis purchases and delivers a bucket of the bat vendors’ protective secretions for Carl. A manually drunk half-bottle sip gives about 30 minutes of broad environmental protection.

events.subject: Prepotente
events.name: Secretions protection analyzed
events.summary: Describes a manually drunk sip of the secretions as granting about half an hour of protection against most environments. No stat increase or exact amount owned is stated.

events.subject: Dario
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Carl’s two Tigran-targeted traps dissolve both One Fine Pig racers; the team is explicitly eliminated because both racers expired.

events.subject: Nico
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Carl’s two Tigran-targeted traps dissolve both One Fine Pig racers; the team is explicitly eliminated because both racers expired.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Second Chance
events.summary: Second Chance is explicitly level 11 before Brain Trust.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Second Chance
events.summary: Brain Trust increases Second Chance from 11 to an effective casting level of 12.

events.subject: Elle McGib
events.name: Brain-freezing spell
events.summary: Carl reports Elle has become proficient with a spell that freezes fluid around the brain. Its formal name and level are not stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Orc corpses
events.summary: Elle lends him many dead orcs, mostly headless, as reserve drivers. He also retains Faction Wars NPC corpses and the dead camel.

events.subject: Elle McGib
events.name: Brain freezing attack
events.summary: Carl describes Elle’s spell that freezes liquid around a target’s brain then makes it explode; no spell name or level is given.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Clockwork Triplicate
events.summary: Donut has used Clockwork Triplicate on the reanimated Olga; the two clockwork copies now exist as replacement drivers.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Raised air intake
events.summary: Hedy has added water protections including a raised air intake to the race truck before the waterslide section.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Sticky hob-lobber
events.summary: Drops and remotely detonates a sticky hob-lobber against pursuing gingers on inner tubes.

events.subject: Florin
events.name: Denial of Service missiles
events.summary: Reports having Denial of Service missiles ready to slow Team Sparkles on the loop; no quantity or firing is yet confirmed.

events.subject: Joel
events.name: Death identified
events.summary: The camel killed by One Fine Pig’s shield at the pit stop is now named Joel; his corpse has a broken neck. The death occurred in Chapter 45.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Second Chance
events.summary: Reanimates Joel’s corpse as a replacement driver. Temporary resurrection does not reverse his permanent death.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Truck spider legs damaged
events.summary: A fall from the wall breaks two truck spider legs; they smoke, but the gyro rights the vehicle and it continues.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Brick wall
events.summary: Casts a spell leaving a brick wall on the track, stopping the gnu and womantaurs but not Team Sparkles.

events.subject: Imani C.
events.name: Engineer rescued
events.summary: Her team kills its slum-track orangutan version of Maurice and rescues the engineer tied in his cook pot.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gutter Bumper
events.summary: Carl has consumed the page granting Gutter Bumper. The page identifies its casting level as 9.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Mehmet Or Book of Boom page
events.summary: Eats Mehmet’s page to activate its associated Gutter Bumper spell.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Gutter Bumper
events.summary: Casts the book-provided Gutter Bumper over the river, shaping Donut’s cone spell along it and increasing its reach by 50%.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Ice Slick
events.summary: Donut casts Ice Slick. The earlier book listed a starting level of 5, but the level of this cast is not stated.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Improvised chained brush hog
events.summary: Deploys chains linking excess nonmagical weapons behind the truck to cut through frozen mobs, then starts cutting the chains loose near the exit.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Summon Ye, Vermin
events.summary: Princess Donut is confirmed to have Summon Ye, Vermin.

events.subject: Maurice
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: The water-park version of Maurice is drilled apart by summoned zipper shrews, completing Pasty Inferno. The engineer prize is also killed, but unnamed.

events.subject: Florin
events.name: Denial of Service missile
events.summary: Fires a missile that sets Team Sparkles’ vine on fire and coats it in goo during the loop.

events.subject: Lucienne
events.name: Death confirmed
events.summary: Still charmed by Donut’s rodent-summoning spell, Lucienne is crushed through the truck windshield by the finish-line barrier because she is outside her own vehicle.

events.subject: Princess Donut
events.name: Lucienne’s racing helmet
events.summary: Loots the cracked racing helmet and identifies its Michale Graves’s disease curse; she considers it worthless, and does not equip it.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Scavenger’s Daughter patch
events.summary: The equipped Scavenger’s Daughter reacts to the presence within Lucia, first unable to identify it and then shuddering in fear after it departs.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Chalchiuhtlicue presence
events.summary: Speaks of the new presence Chalchiuhtlicue communicating through her, then changes to a frightened child’s demeanor.

events.subject: Lucia Mar
events.name: Azra and Yaz identified
events.summary: The speaking child identifies herself as Azra and says Yaz is also present; Carl recognizes them as Mehmet Or’s daughters. This does not assign their bodies Lucia’s stats.

events.subject: Li Na
events.name: Dread
events.summary: Tran reports Li Na cast a dread when teams attacked her, causing racers to kill one another. The dread name, rank and individual victims are not stated.

events.subject: Tran
events.name: Race survival confirmed
events.summary: Explicitly reports he is alive and his team won after Li Na’s dread caused other racers to kill each other.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Heat Four won
events.summary: The Royal Court wins Heat Four. Both Lady Dominators, Team Flamengo, Free Love and Sparkles survive; One Fine Pig is eliminated.

events.subject: Louis Santiago
events.name: Gecko mount
events.summary: Louis uses his house key to add a gecko to his garage and finds an engineer in the hidden room.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Booster rockets
events.summary: The team chooses ordinary booster rockets; together with the bubble these permit large jumps.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Bubble Buddy
events.summary: The vehicle shield is upgraded to the full Bubble Buddy, gaining flotation and protection against molten steel for limited exposure.

events.subject: Carl
events.name: Heat sink
events.summary: The team chooses a heat sink as backup protection if vehicle containment fails.

events.subject: Carl

knownGaps: Donut's character level 1 is strongly implied by later progression and prior site data but is not directly printed in the corpus, so this audit begins her explicit level timeline at 2.
Neither Carl nor Donut receives a separately anchored character-level display for 4 or 6; the next explicit shared displays are 5 and 7.
Donut's character level 11 is not separately displayed; the next explicit shared display is 12.
Mongo has no explicitly displayed stat values, skills, spells, or skill-level changes in Book 1.
Several bulk skill-upgrade passages omit names or final numbers; those events are retained as incomplete rather than silently expanded.
The narrator often collapses low-tier box contents into phrases such as usual potions, torches, biscuits, or crap; exact running counts cannot be recovered from the prose.
Many combat potion uses are implied rather than individually narrated, so consumable totals are lower-bound evidence, not ledger-perfect balances.
The book never exposes Donut's full inventory to Carl; only narrated, equipped, transferred, or opened items can be audited.
Bulk salvage is intentionally grouped rather than expanding every wrench, chair, file, or weight into a separate event.
